purpose: Measure whether RateMySkill is selected for concrete Agent Skill audits without absorbing generic prompt, code, plugin, or installation work.
variance_policy: Repeat every case equally and withhold a pass when threshold compliance is unstable.
selection_rule: a concrete Agent Skill artifact or current workspace plus rating, audit, red-team, publication, discovery, execution, safety, or same-rubric re-review intent
